lots.working: keep_max: lowest surviving close SOLD in good condition = $180 (Gowans 368492, 9ct, 3.7g, Oct 2025). $180 / 1.22 = $147.54, round down to $145. flip_max: likely resale about $220 (small 9ct pairs $180 to $220, ours adds two small diamonds but loses gold to MOP and enamel). Less 15% auction selling commission ($33) and $10 postage or handling = $177. $177 / 2.44 = $72.54, round down to $70. Both assume the weight is at least about 3.5g; check the weight.
lots.confidence_reason: Purity comes from Armitage's acid test (9ct), not a hallmark read in the photo, and weight is unknown; several opened Gowans SOLD 9ct pairs support the value but none is the same design.
